svg.title: The finite-dimensional rank arguments just used have two different domains. For translation rows, the domain at cap d is the real subspace of Q4 i=1 HomC(Fd, Fd+1) consisting of rows that kill the unit, preserve each lower filtered image, commute with conjugation, and transform as a vector under signed permutations. A reading is a position derivative at a fixed separated collinear tuple of the Ward sum P lS(v1, . . . , Tivl, . . . , vn). The free readings have common kernel precisely the real line spanned by the derivative row. Select finitely many such readings by minimizing the dimension of their common kernel. Adjoining a further reading cannot lower that minimal dimension, so this finite kernel already equals the full kernel. Pullback by Uk turns the physical readings into matrices on this one fixed real space; their convergence is (WS7). Eventual rank and the two known rows in their kernels then give the translation normalization stated above. For the internal angular defect, the domain is instead the real subspace
